```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(TFBlearner)   
  library(ggplot2)
  library(PRROC)
  library(scales)
  library(xgboost)
})

set.seed(187)
run_name <- "xgBoost_aggregated"

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")
OUTPUT_DIR   <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")
XGB_DIR      <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "xgBoost_outputs")

# --- load reference data with labels ---
data_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "data_aggregated.tsv")
pred_file <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions", run_name, paste0(run_name, ".tsv"))
training_file  <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "data", "eqtl_files", "training_data_snppg_aggregated.tsv.gz")
evaluationlog <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "predictions", run_name, "evaluationlog.rds")
feature_names <- file.path(XGB_DIR, "models", run_name, "feature_names.txt")
model_dir <-file.path(XGB_DIR, "models", run_name)

index_cols <- c("peak","gene","celltype")

predictions <- fread(pred_file)
full_data <- fread(data_file)
training_data <- fread(training_file)
evaluationlog <- readRDS(evaluationlog)
features <- scan(file.path(model_dir, "feature_names.txt"), what = character())
```

```{r}

ct_map <- c(
  Ast = "astrocytes",
  MG  = "Microglia",
  OD  = "Oligodendrocytes",
  OPC = "OPC",
  IN  = "Neurons",
  Ext = "Neurons",
  End = "Endothelial"
)

remap_ct <- function(x) ifelse(x %in% names(ct_map), ct_map[x], x)
training_data[, celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]
full_data[,     celltype := remap_ct(celltype)]

# merge full features with labels
setkeyv(full_data, index_cols)
setkeyv(training_data, index_cols)
data <- full_data[training_data, nomatch = 0L]

# normalize labels
data[label == 2L, label := 0L]
data <- data[label %in% c(0L, 1L)]
```

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
evaluationlog <- as.data.table(evaluationlog)

plot_df <- melt(
  evaluationlog,
  id.vars = c("iter", "celltype"),
  measure.vars = list(
    AUPR = c("train_aucpr_mean", "test_aucpr_mean"),
    SD   = c("train_aucpr_std",  "test_aucpr_std")
  ),
  variable.name = "dataset"
)

# Label dataset as Train/Test
plot_df[, dataset := fifelse(dataset == 1, "Train", "Test")]

avg_df <- plot_df[, .(
  AUPR = mean(AUPR),
  SD   = mean(SD)   # or sqrt(mean(SD^2)) for pooled
), by = .(iter, dataset)]

ggplot(avg_df, aes(x = iter, y = AUPR, color = dataset, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = AUPR - SD, ymax = AUPR + SD),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  labs(x = "Iteration", y = "AUPR (averaged across CTs)", title = run_name) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)+
  xlim(0, 65)


ggplot(evaluationlog, aes(x = iter, y = test_aucpr_mean, color = celltype)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.9) +
  labs(x = "Boosting round", y = "Test AUPR",
       title = run_name) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```




```{r fig.width=10, fig.height=4}
aupr_prroc <- function(DT, score_col = "xgBoost_probability", label_col = "label") {
  pos_scores <- DT[[score_col]][DT[[label_col]] == 1]
  neg_scores <- DT[[score_col]][DT[[label_col]] == 0]
  if (length(pos_scores) == 0 || length(neg_scores) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos_scores,
                 scores.class1 = neg_scores,
                 curve = TRUE)
  pr
}

setDT(predictions); setkeyv(predictions, index_cols)
setDT(data);        setkeyv(data,        index_cols)

pred_eval <- data[predictions, nomatch = 0L]
pred_eval <- pred_eval[!is.na(xgBoost_probability) & !is.na(label)]
pred_eval[, method := "xgBoost"]

# --- Global curve ---
pr_global <- aupr_prroc(pred_eval)

cat(sprintf("Global AUPR (PRROC): %.4f\n", pr_global$auc.integral))

df_curve <- as.data.table(pr_global$curve)
setnames(df_curve, c("Precision", "Recall", "Threshold"))

# compute global baseline
baseline_global <- mean(pred_eval$label == 1)

ggplot(df_curve, aes(x = Recall, y = Precision)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.9, color = "steelblue", lineend = "round", linejoin = "round") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = baseline_global, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  labs(
    x = "Recall",
    y = "Precision",
    title = sprintf(
      "%s — Global PR Curve (AUPR = %.3f | Baseline = %.3f)",
      run_name, pr_global$auc.integral, baseline_global
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

# --- Celltype curves ---
prs_ct <- lapply(split(pred_eval, pred_eval$celltype), aupr_prroc)

df_all_ct <- rbindlist(lapply(names(prs_ct), function(ct) {
  pr <- prs_ct[[ct]]
  if (is.null(pr)) return(NULL)
  df <- as.data.table(pr$curve)
  setnames(df, c("Precision", "Recall", "Threshold"))
  df[, celltype := ct]
  df
}), fill = TRUE)

# baseline precision per celltype
baseline_ct <- pred_eval[, .(
  baseline = mean(label == 1)
), by = celltype]

# AUPR per celltype
aupr_by_ct <- data.table(
  celltype = names(prs_ct),
  auc_pr   = sapply(prs_ct, function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_real_ else x$auc.integral)
)

# Merge
ct_stats <- merge(baseline_ct, aupr_by_ct, by = "celltype")

# Legend labels
ct_stats[, label := sprintf(
  "%s (AUPR = %.2f | Baseline = %.2f)",
  celltype, auc_pr, baseline
)]

# Plot
ggplot(df_all_ct, aes(x = Recall, y = Precision, color = celltype)) +
  geom_line(size = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(data = ct_stats,
             aes(yintercept = baseline, color = celltype),
             linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = setNames(scales::hue_pal()(nrow(ct_stats)), ct_stats$celltype),
    labels = ct_stats$label
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Recall",
    y = "Precision",
    title = sprintf("%s — PR Curves by Celltype", run_name),
    color = "Celltype"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

ggplot(pred_eval, aes(x = xgBoost_probability, fill = factor(label))) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~celltype) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
model_files <- list.files(
  model_dir,
  pattern = "\\.model$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

importance_list <- lapply(model_files, function(mf) {
  bst <- xgb.load(mf)
  imp <- xgb.importance(model = bst, feature_names = features)
  
  data.table(imp)[, celltype := gsub("xgboost_|\\.model", "", basename(mf))]
})

importance_dt <- rbindlist(importance_list, fill = TRUE)

# take top 10 features per celltype by Gain
top_feats <- importance_dt[, head(.SD, 23), by = celltype]

# compute ordering by decreasing mean Gain across celltypes
feat_order <- top_feats[, .(mean_gain = mean(Gain, na.rm = TRUE)), by = Feature][
  order(mean_gain, decreasing = FALSE)
]$Feature

# apply ordering
top_feats[, Feature := factor(Feature, levels = feat_order)]

# plot grouped bars
ggplot(top_feats, aes(x = Gain, y = Feature, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  labs(
    x = "Importance (Gain)",
    y = "Feature",
    title = "Feature Importance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

```


```{r}
aupr_val <- function(DT, score_col = "xgBoost_probability", label_col = "label") {
  pos_scores <- DT[[score_col]][DT[[label_col]] == 1]
  neg_scores <- DT[[score_col]][DT[[label_col]] == 0]
  if (length(pos_scores) == 0 || length(neg_scores) == 0) return(NA_real_)
  
  pr <- pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos_scores,
                 scores.class1 = neg_scores,
                 curve = TRUE)
  pr$auc.integral
}

DT <- copy(pred_eval)

# bin distances (here: 5kb bins up to 500kb)
bin_size <- 5000
DT[, dist_bin := pmin(500000, floor(peak_gene_distance / bin_size) * bin_size)]

# compute mean score per bin
dist_summary <- DT[, .(
  mean_score = mean(xgBoost_probability, na.rm = TRUE)
), by = dist_bin][order(dist_bin)]

ggplot(dist_summary, aes(x = dist_bin, y = mean_score)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", size = 1) +
  labs(
    x = "Peak–Gene distance (bp)",
    y = "Average xgBoost score",
    title = "xgBoost score vs. Peak–Gene distance"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

dist_summary <- DT[, .(mean_score = mean(xgBoost_probability)), 
                   by = .(dist_bin, celltype)]
ggplot(dist_summary, aes(x = dist_bin, y = mean_score, color = celltype)) +
  geom_line(size = 1)

# Bin distances into categorical ranges
pred_eval[, dist_bin := cut(
  peak_gene_distance,
  breaks = c(0, 10000, 20000, 50000, 100000, 250000, 500000),
  include.lowest = TRUE,
  labels = c("0–10 kb","10-20 kb", "20–50 kb", "50–100 kb", "100–250 kb", "250–500 kb")
)]

# Compute AUPR per bin × celltype
aupr_by_dist_ct <- pred_eval[, .(
  aupr = aupr_val(.SD)   # numeric function from before
), by = .(dist_bin, celltype)]

# Plot
ggplot(aupr_by_dist_ct, aes(x = dist_bin, y = aupr, color = celltype, group = celltype)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Peak–Gene distance bin (bp)",
    y = "AUPR",
    title = "AUPR vs. Peak–Gene distance by Celltype"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
```{r}
library(data.table)

all_features <- c(
  "peak_gene_distance", "closest_tss", "ATACmean", "ATACvariance",
  "cicero", "conservation", "distNearest_peakCentric",
  "predEnhancer_g_exp_beta", "predEnhancer_g_exp_score",
  "predEnhancer_g_lin_beta", "predEnhancer_g_lin_score",
  "predEnhancer_p_exp_beta", "predEnhancer_p_exp_score",
  "predEnhancer_p_lin_beta", "predEnhancer_p_lin_score",
  "rex", "scent", "signac",
  "tad_n_boundaries", "tad_pyt_score", "tad_sum_score",
  "gene_logCPM", "peak_logCPM"
)

# extract only these features as a numeric matrix
linking_feats <- pred_eval[, ..all_features]

# compute correlation matrix
cor_mat <- cor(linking_feats, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
library(corrplot)
corrplot(cor_mat, method = "color", type = "lower",
         tl.col = "black", tl.srt = 45)

library(pheatmap)
pheatmap(cor_mat,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(100),
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         cluster_rows = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE)


all_features <- c(
  "peak_gene_distance", "closest_tss",
  "ATACmean", "ATACvariance", "peak_logCPM",
  "cicero", "conservation", "distNearest_peakCentric",
  "predEnhancer_g_exp_beta", "predEnhancer_g_exp_score",
  "predEnhancer_g_lin_beta", "predEnhancer_g_lin_score",
  "predEnhancer_p_exp_beta", "predEnhancer_p_exp_score",
  "predEnhancer_p_lin_beta", "predEnhancer_p_lin_score",
  "rex", "scent", "signac",
  "tad_n_boundaries", "tad_pyt_score", "tad_sum_score",
  "gene_logCPM"
)

# extract full feature matrix
linking_feats <- pred_eval[, ..all_features]

# z-score normalize each column (so means are comparable)
linking_feats_z <- scale(linking_feats)

# build new grouped feature matrix
group_mat <- data.table(
  peak_gene_distance      = linking_feats_z[, "peak_gene_distance"],
  closest_tss             = linking_feats_z[, "closest_tss"],
  ATAC                    = rowMeans(linking_feats_z[, c("ATACmean","ATACvariance","peak_logCPM")], na.rm = TRUE),
  cicero                  = linking_feats_z[, "cicero"],
  conservation            = linking_feats_z[, "conservation"],
  distNearest_peakCentric = linking_feats_z[, "distNearest_peakCentric"],
  PredEnhancer            = rowMeans(linking_feats_z[, grep("^predEnhancer", colnames(linking_feats_z))], na.rm = TRUE),
  rex                     = linking_feats_z[, "rex"],
  scent                   = linking_feats_z[, "scent"],
  signac                  = linking_feats_z[, "signac"],
  tad_scores              = rowMeans(linking_feats_z[, c("tad_n_boundaries","tad_pyt_score","tad_sum_score")], na.rm = TRUE),
  gene_logCPM             = linking_feats_z[, "gene_logCPM"]
)

# compute correlation
cor_group <- cor(group_mat, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

# plot
pheatmap(cor_group,
         color = colorRampPalette(c("red","white", "purple"))(100),
         display_numbers = TRUE,
         cluster_rows = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = FALSE,
         main = "Correlation of linking features")
```
